payload_laws: container capability does not imply executor capability
symbol tables carry typed addresses; SYMBOL_RESOLVE returns a descriptor and never dereferences it
tensor descriptors reference hash-verified external assets; weights are not embedded
UI and database payloads are requests for registered executors, not MicroXcfe instructions
executor references inside a payload are unverified until the host registry resolves them
semantic graphs serialize as data and do not become executable
execution history remains in JROM; KXML carries references only

node_contract.projection: exact MicroXcfe instruction; @op must equal operator when present
node_contract.authority_phase: must equal the canonical phase of class

CONDITION.reason: semantic condition evaluation is not implemented by MicroXcfe

STRUCTURE.reason: fold markers record boundaries and never authorize phases

CAPABILITY.reason: registry-backed identity or typed address resolution without dereference

CONSEQUENCE.reason: semantic consequence evaluation remains in XCFE

MEMORY.reason: state is discarded after each MicroXcfe request

KUHUL_RUNTIME.reason: K'UHUL runtime control cannot be projected

rejection_reasons.KXML_INVALID_NODE_GRAPH: nodes is missing or not an array
rejection_reasons.KXML_UNKNOWN_NODE_CLASS: class is outside the closed 14-class XCFE set
rejection_reasons.KXML_NODE_NOT_ADMITTED: XCFE admission proof is absent or false
rejection_reasons.KXML_NODE_NOT_PROJECTION_SAFE: operation still requires semantic reasoning or unsafe effects
rejection_reasons.KXML_AUTHORITY_PHASE_MISMATCH: authority phase differs from the class canonical phase
rejection_reasons.KXML_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATOR: operator is outside the class projection subset
rejection_reasons.KXML_OPERATOR_PROJECTION_MISMATCH: projection @op differs from the admitted operator
rejection_reasons.KXML_INVALID_PROJECTION: projection operands or context are malformed
rejection_reasons.KXML_INVALID_PAYLOAD: typed tape payload is malformed or undeclared
rejection_reasons.KXML_PAYLOAD_EXECUTOR_REQUIRED: UI or database request lacks a registered executor reference
rejection_reasons.KXML_PAYLOAD_STATE_COLLISION: inline value conflicts with an existing projection_state binding
rejection_reasons.KXML_SYMBOL_COLLISION: typed symbol key has conflicting declarations
rejection_reasons.KXML_INLINE_TENSOR_FORBIDDEN: tensor weights must remain external hash-addressed assets
rejection_reasons.KXML_LOWERING_CONTRACT_INVALID: host lowering contract is missing or malformed
rejection_reasons.KXML_CALL_NOT_ALLOWLISTED: CALL target is absent from builtin and host stdlib allow-lists
rejection_reasons.KXML_COMMIT_FORBIDDEN: Xul commit cannot lower to MicroXcfe
rejection_reasons.KXML_LOWERING_REQUIRED: raw XCFE graph was sent to a KXML encode or execution route

invariants.L1: admission is established by XCFE before lowering
invariants.L2: projection safety is independent of admission
invariants.L3: MicroXcfe support is independent of admission and safety
invariants.L4: KXML tape content never establishes semantic authority
invariants.L5: FOLD_ENTER and FOLD_EXIT are annotations only
invariants.L6: CALL uses the host registry and cannot self-declare an allow-list
invariants.L7: MEMORY is request-local and cannot persist topology
invariants.L8: COMMIT and phase transitions never lower
